tips: Prioritize creating EN language Reels for Tech, AI, and Business outages, as Reels outperform static posts by over 30x in average score.
Draft headlines around high-stakes, historic milestones (e.g., 'Youngest Governor', 'Historic Political Shift') or major consumer tech disruptions.
Shift away from standard picture (pic) and text-only breaking posts, which consistently receive near-zero views compared to short video formats.
Schedule primary posts during peak engagement windows between 16:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC, while avoiding dead hours between 04:00 UTC and 09:00 UTC.
Avoid duplicate postings and generic political updates on Asia, Americas, or Middle East without a strong viral hook.

news.summary: Data se saaf pata chalta hai ke English Reels sab se zyada views aur engagement la rahi hain, jabke simple pics aur text breaking news perform nahi kar rahien. Tech, Business outages, aur historic political updates par bane Reels ne sab se behtareen score diya hai. Postings ke liye shaam 16:00 se 20:00 UTC ka waqt sab se best hai. Weak topics (Asia, Americas, Middle East) ka volume kam karke Business, Tech aur Pakistan content par Reels focus barha diya gaya hai.
